items.title: ShinyHunters Suspect Rey Reportedly Detained in Jordan, Helping FBI Identify Group Members
items.description: A suspected member of the ShinyHunters digital extortion group, who goes by the online alias "Rey," has been allegedly detained by authorities in Jordan, Reuters reported, citing three people familiar with the matter. items.title: Vercel Confirms KVM Zero-Day VM Escape, Awards Researcher $50,000
items.description: Vercel has confirmed a KVM zero-day vulnerability after security researcher Paulos Yibelo reported a full virtual machine escape that, he says, allows code inside a guest to gain root access on the host.
